answer_1.quote: we formally define and model the task of mnemonic generation, where learners author cues to help themselves memorize kanji.
answer_1.outputs: verbal mnemonic cues for Japanese kanji

answer_2.quote: We utilize BERTScore, ROUGE. BERTScore measures semantic similarity between model outputs and human-authored mnemonics, while ROUGE measures lexical overlap.

answer_3.quote: We utilize Prometheus evaluation model for a head-to-head evaluation, comparing the mnemonics generated by our method against that generated by SFT, which mnemonic is more similar to the ground-truth, and measure the Win Rate.
